title: Attention Illuminates LLM Reasoning: The Preplan-and-Anchor Rhythm Enables Fine-Grained Policy Optimization
one_line_claim: LLMs exhibit a recurring preplan-and-anchor rhythm in attention patterns detectable via windowed average attention distance and future attention influence, enabling fine-grained credit assignment in RL.
method_summary: Analyzes attention maps from LLM generation on mathematical reasoning, identifying preplan tokens (windowed average attention distance) and anchor tokens (future attention influence). These tokens guide fine-grained credit assignment in group relative policy optimization, rewarding tokens proportional to their structural importance.

key_findings.finding: LLMs exhibit a consistent preplan-and-anchor rhythm where preplan tokens have elevated entropy and anchor tokens receive high future attention influence.
key_findings.quote: We discover that LLMs exhibit a consistent rhythm: preplan tokens with high WAAD maintain higher token entropies, and anchor tokens with high FAI are predominantly receiver heads and global heads.

key_findings.finding: Three coupling patterns: WAAD peaks maintain 51.97% higher entropy, FAI peaks of receiver/global heads co-occur 171.49% more, FAI peaks follow WAAD peaks 42.47% more often.
key_findings.quote: Concretely, we observe three coupling patterns: (1) WAAD peaks maintain +51.97% higher token entropies; (2) receiver heads and global heads share anchors with +171.49% FAI peak co-occurrence; (3) FAI peaks follow or coincide with WAAD peaks at +42.47% higher rate.

key_findings.finding: Fine-grained credit assignment targeting preplan-and-anchor rhythm achieves 4.2-17.6% improvements across mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
key_findings.quote: Our coupled rhythm credit strategy achieves +4.2% on GSM8K, +7.2% on MATH-500, +6.8% on AIME24, +8.1% on AIME25, +7.9% on AMC23, +6.3% on Olympiad, +12.5% on Countdown, and +17.6% on CrossThinkQA.

limitations: Focuses exclusively on mathematical reasoning; generalization to other reasoning domains not explored.
Conducted on models up to 7B parameters; scaling unclear.
Requires explicit attention map access, limiting black-box applicability.

relation_to_herald.shared: Both leverage per-token internal signals (attention vs. logit distributions) extracted during generation to improve LLM behavior without retraining.
differs_on: HERALD predicts catastrophic failures induced by KV-cache compression at inference time; this paper optimizes reasoning structure via fine-grained credit assignment in RL training.
HERALD uses entropy/uncertainty statistics from logits as failure signals; this paper uses attention-based metrics (WAAD, FAI) to identify structural tokens.
HERALD operates inference-time in a compression-degradation regime; this paper operates training-time on uncompressed reasoning.
